summaries.R1-L1: Over-invoicing can move extra money to the seller disguised as payment for goods. The officer could ask the customer to explain the exceptionally high price for these items.
summaries.R2-L1: An implausible quantity-to-value ratio can indicate misrepresentation of goods to move illicit funds. The officer could ask for documentation supporting the declared value for this quantity of goods.
summaries.R4-INV: Inconsistent origin and loading port without explanation can obscure the true source or destination of goods. The officer could ask the customer to provide a reason for the goods being loaded in a different country from their stated origin.
